scope: Actual permitted 3D acquisition plus catalog, builder and product-viewer integration. No universal-model or manufacturing-fit coverage claim.

implementation.catalogMethod: prepareCatalog(records) mutates only the eight new stable IDs and two scoped existing-ID overrides; repeat calls are safe.
implementation.browserMethod: writeBrowserCatalog(records) produces dist/completion-catalog.js. Existing products receive scoped patches; compact builder catalogs are never expanded by the script.
implementation.registryMethod: registry() returns 105 unchanged existing mappings plus 10 individually attributed additions and checks prepared binary hashes.
implementation.builder: Selected GPU/CPU/board/case/cooler inspector has an explicit View part in 3D action. New sources use isolated, uniform auto framing. Show build layout restores the existing approximate assembly.
implementation.product: Product pages use the same isolated renderer with no initial Three or GLB request. Close/reset/front/side/rotate/zoom, focus restoration, loading cancellation, recoverable errors and context-loss/pagehide cleanup are implemented. Product markup is now connected by the parent build-pages integration.
implementation.buildLibrary: scripts/build-model-library.cjs appends the new mappings and records practicalBuilder, standaloneOnly and historical/reference coverage separately.

rootIntegration.productOptions: options.model must include completion mappings. Retain license, current and original embedded author, source and modification credit.
rootIntegration.filters: builderEligible:false records are references, not practical builder recommendations. indexable:false applies to MasterBox Lite 5 and i5-661 while exact documentation is incomplete. Preserve useful existing historical pages.
rootIntegration.browserScript: Load completion-catalog after core/retail/cooling on full interactive pages and include it in the source VM. Exclude it from compact payload templates.
rootIntegration.coverage: Add cooler category to the coverage template and use practicalBuilder counts when discussing the practical selector.

reproduction.purpose: Recheck each exact individually licensed source. Cached import metadata expires after seven days.
Read the exact user ZIP or public indexed licensed GLB. No authentication bypass, protected viewer extraction or proxy.
Retain geometry/texture identity, preserve proportions and record modifications. Only the two specifically reviewed TITAN fan tracks are omitted.
Khronos validation, Meshopt decode, finite geometry, source/output hash, topology and self-contained texture/buffer checks.
46 model/controller/product-viewer tests including ninety real-source camera-projection cases. GPU rendering is mocked; parent performs actual browser rendering.

dependencies.localArchive: User-provided Downloads/amd-wraith-stealth-cpu-cooler.zip; existing ZIP is read only and checked by CRC/topology.

performed: 10 real GLBs: 0 Khronos errors, 3 Wraith generated-tangent-space warnings
All 10 files decoded through Meshopt with finite positions and preserved source triangle counts/bounds
All 24 embedded images in the ten prepared GLBs fully pixel-decoded; TITAN material factors match archived source exactly.
83 combined model, product-viewer, scene, cooler, engine and image tests passed (0 failures).
All eight new product images pixel-decoded and visually reviewed. Five exact official sources; three actual licensed model renders.
90 real-source-envelope view/viewport projection cases stay inside the padded frustum; parent Reset screenshots confirm i5 and ASUS fit without camera changes.
notPerformed: No production deployment or global generator by this agent
No manufacturer clearance, thermal, connector or acoustic certification
Real GPU browser inspection is performed by parent; screenshots and recorded DOM/camera data are retained. This agent reviewed image pixels and terminal validations.
validation.releaseGate: Parent performs the combined build, real desktop/mobile browser inspection and deployment verification.

knownLimitations: Parent has confirmed actual TITAN/i5/ASUS textured runtime rendering. Combined build, broader mobile release approval and production verification remain owned by parent.
No old asset, catalog identity or license mapping is replaced by this module.
All ten files can be used as isolated source appearances; complete installed-PC placement is deliberately not certified.
